claims.claim_text: Marxist Unity Group believes that only an independent socialist movement can provide the basis for a strong and independent labor movement.

Marxist Unity Group believes that only an independent socialist movement is able to democratically resolve workers’ particular different interests across sectors in order to articulate demands together as a class.
Marxist Unity Group will embrace the struggle for political reforms and economic improvements.
